## What's new

- **Lighter on your computer.** RayLink no longer keeps redrawing its window while it sits connected, so CPU and graphics use drop sharply, with or without animations. Nothing redraws at all while the window is closed to the tray.
- **Auto Connect works.** With Auto Connect on, RayLink connects to your selected server when it starts.
- **Connect on Demand and Wi-Fi rules work.** On a computer, Connect on Demand keeps you connected and reconnects after a drop. On trusted Wi-Fi networks RayLink doesn't connect by itself, and on blocked ones it disconnects. Windows 11 and macOS share the Wi-Fi name only with apps that have location access, and RayLink tells you when it needs it.
- **A new Share screen.** Sharing a subscription shows its QR code and link right away, with Copy URL and Copy Configs buttons below.
- **Softer buttons.** Buttons glow gently in their own shape when you point at or press them, instead of showing a grey box.
- **Android icon and splash.** The app icon and the launch screen show the whole shield; on some phones half of it was cut off.
